test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A place for ammunition and weapons
solution:
The correct answer is: **Arsenal**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Arsenal **means a building where military weapons and explosives are made or stored. (स्‍थान जहाँ सैन्‍य सामग्री बनाई या जमा रखी जाती है; शस्‍त्रागार, आयुधनिर्माणशाला)
 
• So, it is clear that '**Arsenal**' can be used as a one-word substitute for '**A place for ammunition and weapons** '

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Arena **means an area of activity that concerns the public. (गतिविधि का एक क्षेत्र जो जनता से संबंधित है)
 
• **Abattoir **means a place where animals are butchered : slaughterhouse. (वह स्थान जहाँ पशुओं का वध किया जाता हो: बूचड़खाना)
 
• **Aviary **means a large cage or area in which birds are kept. (एक बड़ा पिंजरा या क्षेत्र जिसमें पक्षी रखे जाते हैं)
